title: Fail closed when an expected historical exact-snapshot regression test is absent
mission: Make the exact-snapshot Frontier Pressure regression lane fail closed when an expected regression test path is absent, while preserving exact source identity, request transport, workflow_dispatch and self-test behavior.
definition_of_done: An absent expected regression file produces nonzero regression-step status and a durable FAIL receipt.
Historical snapshot policy explicitly defines whether the test manifest comes from the target snapshot or the current workflow envelope.
Exact requested SHA == checked-out SHA remains enforced.
Existing durable request transport and self-test/workflow_dispatch behavior remain unchanged.
Relevant regression tests and efficiency-ratchet checks pass.
No Current/Human Accepted/Served or production /w authority is promoted.
